app.name: Pharmacy Inventory
app.tagline: Multi-branch pharmacy inventory, POS and loyalty management

auth.signInHint: Sign in with the account your pharmacy owner invited you with.
auth.trust: Protected by two-factor authentication and row-level security.
auth.heroTitle: Run every branch from one place
auth.heroBody: Fast counter billing, expiry-first stock, loyalty cards and live reports — built for Bangladeshi pharmacies.
heroPoints: Nearest-expiry stock is sold first, automatically
Bangla and English, light and dark
Owner sees every branch in real time
auth.mfaVerifyBody: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.mfaEnrollBody: Owners and managers must protect their account. Scan this QR code with Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator, then enter the 6-digit code.
auth.mfaSecret: Can't scan? Enter this key manually
auth.skipHint: Salespeople may skip. Owner and manager features stay locked until this is set up.
auth.codeInvalid: That code didn't work. Check the time on your phone and try again.

onboarding.title: Set up your pharmacy
onboarding.body: Create your pharmacy and its first branch. You can add more branches and staff later.
onboarding.branchCodeHint: 2–6 letters, printed on invoices (e.g. MPR → MPR-2627-000001).
onboarding.noAccessBody: If you are an owner or manager, finish two-factor setup to see your pharmacy. Otherwise ask the owner to invite you.

dashboard.subtitle: Here's how {{branch}} is doing today.
dashboard.salesTrendBody: Net sales after returns and voids
dashboard.expiringBody: Batches expiring in the next {{days}} days

pos.emptyCartBody: Search for a medicine and press Enter to add it.
pos.estimateNote: Final price, loyalty discount and batch allocation are calculated securely by the server.
pos.prescriptionBody: This bill contains controlled or prescription-only medicines.
